what: The 8px white dot at the end of the pill button grows into a 24px dark circle on hover (.8s), and .2s later an arrow inside it appears, scaling 0→1 over .6s. The button background changes from dark navy to the accent color in .8s. On hover-out everything returns in .3s (STUDIO hover — long going in, short coming out, curve .4,.4,0,1). The ‹ring› type is the ring on card and list-row corners (a 16px navy circle with an 8px white dot) where the white dot grows into the same circle and covers it

options.look: ring: Ring on the card and list row corner — does not change the button background
options.--fx-dot: Grown circle color, default deep navy (the accent color darkened)

use: See more

from.where: shared.css .t7-pill · .t7-dot (pill button #24274a→#004098 · dot 8→24px · arrow .6s .2s late) · .t7-hot .t7-dot.is-ring (ring on the corner of Awards·Investment·News rows). Original STUDIO hover state 800ms, background all .3s, curve (.4,.4,0,1). With motion-probe, enter ≈567ms · exit ≈200ms (the curve end settles fast, so the measured length is short)
